title: WP Title Description - Rework 1
outcome_summary: All nine deferred/out-of-scope items from the `2026-08-01-wp-title-description` parent project were implemented in a single session. The schema hardening, test improvements, CSS decoupling, title truncation UX, documentation audit, and trust boundary documentation are all live. All 3970 existing tests continue to pass with zero TypeScript errors.
project_summary: This project closes all deferred and out-of-scope items from the wp-title-description parent project, which added title and description fields to the Work Package data model. The six independent changes cover schema validation hardening, test coverage improvement, GUI CSS decoupling with a .rendered-markdown utility class, title truncation UX with native browser tooltips, api-surface.md documentation audits, and a new trust boundary gotcha for marked.parse markdown rendering.
